alignment_method: Montreal Forced Aligner, automatic (not hand-verified ground truth)
phone_input_policy: Only the aligned phone waveform, no neighboring words/phones. Normalize RMS, taper 5 ms at edges, center in 0.5 s of zero padding. All encoders use four temporal-bin means. SPARC follows the same input policy before its normalization/padding/filtering.
selection: Deterministic hash order, exclude unknown words and boundary crossings; stressed vowels only; cap each phone per speaker and at most one occurrence per word type per phone/speaker.
model_selection: Fit on development training speakers; select representation by balanced accuracy on development validation speakers. Freeze selection before final test scoring. Use C=0.1 throughout.
promotion_gate: At least 0.85 validation balanced accuracy and 0.85 final-test balanced accuracy, with final speaker-bootstrap CI lower bound >=0.80. Demos also require >=0.80 balanced accuracy under +/-20 ms boundary shifts, 20 dB added noise, and a central crop of at most 160 ms on a deterministic test subset. This establishes corpus discrimination only, not learner improvement or anatomical coaching.
